name: Rep-count regression and hot-path benchmark
description: On saving analysis/engine sources, run the fixture rep-count parity harness and the ingest hot-path benchmark.

action.prompt: Analysis source changed. Run the fixture rep-count parity harness (old vs new implementation over all fixtures) and BLOCK on any rep-count regression, per spec 02 testing strategy. Then run the ingest hot-path benchmark and confirm it stays <= 3 ms p95 with all specs loaded (tech.md budget). Report regressions with the fixture id, expected vs actual rep count, and the p95 timing.
